Streak-ladder board 954x621 - the compounding 1.00x/1.96x/3.92x/7.84x/15.68x/31.36x ladder with a cash-out card. MISSING RELATION: supabase/functions/points-game/index.ts routes `play_rps` and nothing else; the ladder engine (rpsStreakApply, rpsStreakCashoutBps in supabase/functions/_shared/rps.ts) is wired to NO action, so there is no start / round / cashout endpoint to drive it. Also an economics conflict: the engine prices a ladder win at 1.90 and the deployed single-shot rail pays 1.85x, against the frame's 1.96 - its own comment calls 1.96 `a 2% edge, not 5%`. Deliberately not built (RockPaperScissorsGame.tsx:43-49).

BINGO CARD IS NOT A BINGO CARD. Measured on 9794:12346 by x-bucket (B 293 / I 379 / N 466 / G 549 / O 635): B=37,49,9,19,42 (range 1-15) I=27,22,13,18,56 (16-30) N=12,67,-,3,83 (31-45) G=92,21,85,52,10 (46-60) O=29,48,76,35,19 (61-75). 19 of the 24 filled cells fall outside their own column's range, four values (76,83,85,92) exceed the 75-ball pool entirely, and 19 appears twice on one card.
